ruleset.name: Teedy Custom Metrics
ruleset.description: Custom PMD ruleset focused on structural metrics for the Teedy Java modules.

rule.name: LinesOfCode
rule.message: This declaration exceeds the configured Lines of Code (LoC) threshold.
rule.description: Reports classes, methods, and constructors whose physical lines of code exceed the configured limits.

property.name: maxClassLoc
property.description: Maximum allowed LoC for a class

property.name: maxExecutableLoc
property.description: Maximum allowed LoC for a method or constructor

rule.name: WeightedMethodsPerClass
rule.message: This class exceeds the configured Weighted Methods per Class (WMC) threshold.
rule.description: Reports concrete classes whose weighted method count is above the configured threshold.

property.name: maxWmc
property.description: Maximum allowed WMC for a class

rule.name: LackOfCohesionInMethods
rule.message: This class shows low cohesion and should be reviewed for LCOM-related design issues.
rule.description: PMD 7 exposes Tight Class Cohesion (TCC) as a built-in Java metric rather than a direct LCOM metric. This rule flags classes whose TCC is below the configured minimum, which is the inverse signal of high lack of cohesion in methods (LCOM-style) behaviour.

property.name: minimumMethodCount
property.description: Minimum number of methods before cohesion is evaluated

property.name: minTcc
property.description: Minimum acceptable Tight Class Cohesion (inverse indicator of LCOM)
